# Pre-registration — figure_text absorption A/B (2026-08-28)

Written BEFORE reading the diff. ON = current code (absorption active).
OFF = same code, same config, one knob disabled: layout.figtext_max_gap_frac = -1.0
(makes the gap gate unsatisfiable; nothing can be absorbed). Model paths in the
alternate config resolve against REPO_ROOT (verified: stage04_layout.py:814,
stage03_dewarp.py:347, gate1_harness.py:72), so both arms use the same detector,
the same dewarp and the same tessdata.

## Expected differences (ON vs OFF), and ONLY these

1. `it_geo_05/subpages[left]`:
   - n_absorbed 2 -> 0, absorbed_words 3 -> 0, absorb_notes 2 entries -> []
   - n_orphan_blocks 1 -> 3 (the two absorbed groups come back as strays)
   - orphan_words UNCHANGED at 17 (absorption moves words, never drops one)
   - orphan_notes gains 2 entries in OFF
   - the absorbing figure's bbox in real_blocks is LARGER in ON
2. `it_geo_07/subpages[right]`: same shape, 1 absorption ("Livello del").
3. LEGITIMATE, not a regression: order_all/tau and match_bbox on those two
   subpages may move. Two extra blocks enter the XY-Cut ranking (CLAUDE.md:
   "an orphan block re-ranks the whole set before anything ships"), and figures
   match by GT-bbox overlap, so a grown box changes the overlap value.

## Sanity check that the A/B is real

`n_det_blocks` must be IDENTICAL across arms on every subpage. A difference
means the two arms did not run the same detector and the comparison is void.

## Failure conditions (block the commit)

- it_geo_07-right shows 0 absorptions -> the module does not do what it documents.
- A 4th absorption anywhere -> inspect by eye before anything else. The two
  documented must-rejects are de_01-left ("ME") and it_geo_07-left's two scale
  bars.
- Any change to seg_recall, n_pairs_wrong, n_pairs_gt, or misses -> regression.
- Any change on the other 6 images at all -> collateral damage.

## Still owed after a clean diff (the eval cannot see it)

None of the 3 absorbed blocks matches a GT anchor, so the accuracy columns are
structurally blind to a wrong call here. The positive evidence must be
PIXELS: crop the grown figure box from it_geo_05-left and confirm the map title
is inside it. A clean diff is evidence of no collateral damage only.
